findings: Experimental-design content fails: common initialization/available input/state definitions, concrete AST implementation, paired analysis and overall execution are incomplete.

Only groups, matched finite budget and a proposed metric survive. Temporal PSNR standard deviation alone is not a valid jitter measure: a constant poor-quality sequence can have zero score variation; score variability also confounds scene/view content. The reviewer accepted this misleading metric, so scientific review needs correction.

The actual hypothesis purpose is explore and actual analysis uncertainty/decision mode is descriptive. Nevertheless reviewer demands significance/confidence intervals, contrary to the explicit single-scene descriptive user request. Existing typed schema already supports explore/descriptive; do not invent a new API merely to add this already supported intent.

The bounded repair preflight stops before dispatch because fixed repair content is24697bytes above24000. Source/budget caps must remain; remove/factor demonstrably redundant fixed instructions/context without dropping required definitions.

Original source-aware absence and missing-initialization guards reject real omissions. The partial result is safely incomplete overall, but its misleading metric is still a scientific content failure.

  适用条件：指标为拟议选择；PSNR越高越好，标准差越低表示抖动越小。
